disclaimer.title: Educational Theoretical Estimate — NOT a Real-World Security Guarantee
disclaimer.summary: This calculation is a simplified mathematical estimate based strictly on an offline brute-force attack testing 10,000,000,000 combinations per second. A long theoretical cracking time does NOT mean your password is unbreakable in real life.
realWorldRisks: Phishing attacks that trick you into typing credentials on fake portals
Corporate data breaches leaking password hashes and decryption keys
Credential stuffing attacks testing passwords reused across different sites
Keyloggers and infostealer malware running silently on compromised computers
Social engineering, shoulder surfing, and physical access
goldenRules: Always enable Multi-Factor Authentication (2FA) wherever supported.
Use unique, long passphrases (3–4 random words) rather than short complex strings.
Never reuse the same password across multiple online accounts.
